title: 28-year-old woman, 39 weeks pregnant, who collapsed
arrival: A 28-year-old woman initially collapsed while shopping. She is 39 weeks pregnant. During the triage assessment, she reports feeling tired and weak.

checkpoints.why: She becomes unresponsive during the assessment. This is the first red criterion, and no further assessment is needed before escalating.

feedbackWhy: She becomes unresponsive during the assessment.
teachingPoint: Her pregnancy at 39 weeks means the obstetric team should be involved early, but the RED category is already determined by her unresponsiveness alone.

unresponsive.text: Becomes unresponsive during the triage assessment.
